item.text:
Added an accessible kebab menu to the [Current session header](/app/src/components/views/settings/devices/CurrentDeviceSection.tsx:60). It offers destructive “Sign out” and, when another session exists, “Sign out all other sessions.” The [reusable menu](/app/src/components/views/context_menus/KebabContextMenu.tsx:24) supports keyboard navigation, closes on activation, and returns focus to its trigger. Bulk sign-out passes only non-current device IDs.

Three native subagents handled the component and styles, session integration, and tests; I reviewed and verified the combined patch. The four focused suites pass (68 tests, 9 snapshots), as do the existing Message and Space menu suites (44 tests). ESLint and Stylelint pass. The full TypeScript check still reports unrelated existing SDK type errors.
